repair.name: LINEATION_CONFOUNDER_PENALTY_V1_1
repair.reason: Strong coherent lineation is a known ordinary-geology confounder at Puy des Folles. It should reduce a chimney-like morphology rank, while the tile remains visible as a confounder rather than being discarded.
repair.parameter_origin: Selected during synthetic adversarial QA before numeric FKt230303 grid scoring. It is therefore frozen for the first field-grid pass and may not be retuned after field labels are scored.

TOPA_interpretation: The failure mode was reduced without using real FKt230303 numeric labels.
The pit field moved upward and remains a strong adversarial morphology family; this is desirable because the engine must expose rather than hide remaining false positives.

Passing this synthetic repair is not evidence of real-world specificity. Real bathymetry may contain lineated vents, non-lineated scarps, lava knobs, acquisition artifacts and scale effects absent from the fixture.

frozen_first_field_pass.tile_scales: must be converted from physical metres when grid spacing metadata are available; do not silently treat pixels as metres
